scope: Two fixed existing development scenes, one renderer seed1111; no fresh access, no arm selection

paired_two_development_latent_and_decode.pixel_route: Direct frozen VAE decode, not VACE diffusion generation

conclusions: CNN and linear true_source, true_target and residual_source GPU denoised latents and PNG bytes match exactly in both scenes.

On two fixed development renders the CNN absolute route has lower hole/destination RGB error, while linear has lower global/background RGB error and centroid error; neither architecture is uniformly superior.
The CNN initial residual route has lower edited-region errors and centroid error than linear in the two fixed renders, while both retain source-position artifacts.
On the SAME two decoded transport scenes, no-F local has lower mean global/hole/destination latent error AND lower mean global/hole/destination decoded RGB error than learned residual.

Learned transported residual has lower mean latent error over ALL EIGHT development scenes; comparing this eight-scene ranking with the two-scene decoded ranking is a scene-subset confound, not demonstrated metric-ranking reversal.
No primary method, qualification threshold, or test specification changed; no fresh scenes were accessed.
